title: AI Infrastructure Monitoring and Operations
summary: Combine compute, storage, network, power, cooling, and service telemetry before recommending a safe action.
objectives: Document observations, hypotheses, uncertainty, and escalation.

vocab.def: Collected measurements or status information about a system.
The ability of a service or system to remain usable as expected.
Comparing related signals without assuming one proves causation.

sections.heading: Read the whole system
sections.body: A synthetic AI workload may show GPU utilization, memory pressure, storage latency, network throughput, power draw, temperature, and node status. Compare signals and service expectations.

sections.heading: Operations before conclusions
sections.body: Confirm the symptom, gather evidence, check recent changes, test only approved low-risk hypotheses, verify, document, and escalate when permission or uncertainty requires it.

practice.prompt: GPU use is high, network is normal, memory pressure is high, and temperature is rising. What should be documented?
practice.answer: Each observation, the affected workload or node hypothesis, uncertainty about cause, and a safe authorized next step.

reflectionPrompt: What evidence would you verify before declaring a workload restored?
